claim_boundary: This artifact proves exact exponent algebra and finite-threshold implications conditional on two explicitly CONJECTURED premises. It proves neither Montgomery's conjecture nor CRR-U, and it gives no density, prime-interval, saturation, or L-function theorem.

crr_translation.coefficient_translation: c_n=w(n/L)b_n has |c_n|<=1 and support within [L,2L]; deleting the possible n=L term changes the value by at most 1
crr_translation.endpoint_threshold_condition: For fixed pointwise margin p>0, delta(v)<p/2 and v^(p/2)>2 imply |D_v^+(t)|>L^sigma.

falsifier.statement: An unbounded CRR Base-witness sequence falsifies the stated fixed-epsilon Montgomery premise throughout the open sigma interval; a finite witness does neither.

fixed_sigma_reduction.conclusion: Any unbounded CRR Base-witness sequence contradicts that conjectural fixed-epsilon premise.
fixed_sigma_reduction.does_not_conclude: CRR-U, absence of a CRR witness, a density gain, or method saturation

general_sigma_reduction.conclusion: Any unbounded CRR Base-witness sequence contradicts the corresponding conjectural fixed-epsilon premise at every fixed sigma in the open interval.
general_sigma_reduction.conditional_on: montgomery_fixed_epsilon_premise at each fixed sigma in (3/5,7/10) with epsilon=(20*sigma-12)/48
general_sigma_reduction.endpoint_exclusion: At sigma=3/5 the cardinality gap is zero; at sigma=7/10 the pointwise margin is zero.

joint_saving_bridge.conclusion: The stated joint-saving upper bound contradicts the Base cardinality lower bound for all sufficiently large v and hence implies CRR-U.
joint_saving_bridge.conditional_on: a uniform CONJECTURED upper bound C(epsilon)v^epsilon(v^6+v^(8-kappa_2)+v^(8-kappa_3)) with fixed kappa_2,kappa_3>0

montgomery_fixed_epsilon_premise.statement: For each fixed sigma>1/2 and epsilon>0, constants C(sigma,epsilon), X_0(sigma,epsilon) give |W|<=C(sigma,epsilon)T^epsilon N^(2-2sigma) for all sufficiently large admissible inputs.

one_saving_limit.scope: exponent comparison in the displayed three-term architecture only
one_saving_limit.statement: With one unsaved tied term v^8, the dominant upper exponent remains 8; no fixed positive exponent gap against v^(8-delta(v)) follows from this comparison alone.

research_stage_review_policy.lightweight_checks: source transcription, exact Fraction algebra, frozen-input hashes, replay, and tamper rejection
